state.seed_assertion: Verification of a fix should include running equipment through full operational cycles and testing boundary conditions before considering the problem solved.

sentences.1: On the other hand, hardware faults tend to be affected by the end environment, which can include cables and other site-specific conditions.
sentences.2: Possible causes include a forced-off condition in the program, an incorrect I/O tree mapping after a module replacement, or a faulted slot that has been inhibited.
sentences.3: Physical stress testing on cabling and connectors, vibration testing, and thermal cycling can reveal wiring and soldering issues.
sentences.4: Physical stress on cabling and connectors as well as vibration and thermal cycling (heat gun and freeze spray) can often chase out wiring and soldering issues.
sentences.5: Data loggers enable teams to transition from reactive maintenance to proactive problem-solving.
sentences.6: Industrial DAQ systems give teams the power to move from reactive maintenance to proactive problem-solving.
sentences.7: Software faults tend to be repeatable and occur when a specific set of conditions is present, whereas hardware faults are affected by environmental conditions.
sentences.8: A software fault may seem intermittent, but normally this is because a very specific set of conditions needs to be present to cause the fault.
